snippet.title: Forsworn | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Official gameplay trailer for Forsworn, an upcoming roguelike turn-based tactical RPG where no hero fights alone - build powerful synergies to overcome unforgiving battles. Venture into a realm consumed by divine war, where lost secrets and defiance of the gods await.

Inspired by the tactical depth of Baldur’s Gate 3, and XCOM, overcome brutal encounters while strategically building powerful party synergies. Items and upgrades don’t just raise stats - they evolve abilities, unlock new mechanics, and deepen hero playstyles.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560360/Forsworn/

Demo drops Dec. 1st!

Join the official Discord to follow development: https://discord.gg/VbpqawJAvY

#turnbasedtactics  #roguelike #indiegames #forsworn
